title: b11985
description: metal : faster MXFP4 mat-vec, full threadgroups for unary/binary/GLU ( #31075 ) metal : faster MXFP4 mat-vec kernel Decode the fp4 values with the fp16 bit trick instead of a threadgroup lookup table, and load the packed nibbles as aligned 32-bit words. The kernel no longer uses threadgroup memory. metal : launch contiguous unary and binary ops with full threadgroups The contiguous unary path and the row-broadcast binary path used one thread per threadgroup. Use up to 256 threads per threadgroup
